rules.sentence: Before targeted pulmonary hypertension therapy is started, cardiac catheterization should be performed to assess vasodilator responsiveness.
A trial of CCB treatment should only be conducted in patients who have previously demonstrated acute reactivity to inhaled nitric oxide or intravenous epoprostenol.
Long-term CCB therapies recommended for use in acute responders include nifedipine at a dose of 2 to 5 mg/kg once daily.[12]
